title: Categories column sorts by count, most first on the first click
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A, pricing three new categories made for this test.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix B, pricing one new category made for this test.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix C, pricing two new categories made for this test.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Matrices tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click the Categories column header.
  3. Click the Categories column header again.
  4. Click the Matrix column header.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Matrix A, matrix B and matrix C are listed by name.

Step 2:

  • Matrices with more categories come first: matrix A (3) above matrix C (2) above matrix B (1).

Step 3:

  • The order reverses: matrix B (1) above matrix C (2) above matrix A (3).

Step 4:

  • The list is sorted by matrix name.
  • Matrix A comes before matrix B, which comes before matrix C, in name order.
